entities.name: Lester Quiñones
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lester Quiñones is a Dominican-American professional basketball player for the Osceola Magic of the NBA G League. He attended St. Benedict's Preparatory School and played a postgraduate season at IMG Academy. He then played college basketball for the Memphis Tigers.
